rule_text.name: 702.208a
rule_text.rule: Shimmer is a triggered ability that may create one or more delayed triggered abilities. “Shimmer” means “Whenever this creature attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that’s a copy of it.” and “Exile that token at the beginning of the end step.”

rule_text.name: 702.208b
rule_text.rule: If a creature has multiple instances of shimmer, each triggers separately.

rule_text.name: 702.208c
rule_text.rule: The delayed trigger will retrigger at every end step. If the trigger is countered, or avoided by ending the turn, the token will remain on the battlefield and the ability will trigger on the next end step.

rule_text.name: 702.208d
rule_text.rule: Shimmer will only exile tokens created by its ability. Replacement effects such as Doubling Season cause shimmer to create two tokens, and both will be exiled. Effects that create a copy of those tokens, such as populate, will create a token will not attempt to be exiled every end step.

rule_text.name: 702.208e
rule_text.rule: If shimmer creates multiple tokens, each one will have its own end step exile trigger.

rule_text.name: 702.215a
rule_text.rule: Primal is a static ability that functions while the spell with primal is on the stack. “Primal (cost)” means “During your turn, you may cast this spell for (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost. If you do, casting this spell also counts as playing a land.”

rule_text.name: 702.215b
rule_text.rule: The spell with primal is still cast. It is not a special action, it only counts as playing a land when determining if a player can play a land this turn.

rule_text.name: 702.215c
rule_text.rule: A spell can be cast for its primal cost at any point during a player's turn, as long as the number of lands that player can play this turn is greater than the number of lands they have already played this turn, even if timing restrictions would normally prevent playing a land. This means a spell may be cast for its primal cost during its owner's upkeep or end step, but not during another player's turn, or during a turn where lands can't be played.

rule_text.name: 702.215d
rule_text.rule: Additional land plays allow you to play additional cards for their primal cost.
